en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a man and a woman in traditional Macedonian rural costumes. The man wears a fez-like cap, a vest, a wide belt, a pleated white skirt over trousers, and traditional shoes. The woman wears a richly decorated headdress, layered garments, an embroidered apron, and long skirt. Below the photograph there is printed multilingual caption text describing the scene and location, including the word 'SALONIQUE' and 'SALONICA — Macedonian country costumes.'
